meaning:
§ Tob = "good"
a region east of the Jordan, north or northeast of Gilead, probably Aramean, location uncertain

elsewhere.note: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.
When the children of Ammon saw that they had become odious to David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth Rehob, and the Syrians of Zobah…
